sloka: सिंह विप्रेक्षितौ वीरौ महाबल पराक्रमौ ।शक्र चाप निभे चापे गृहीत्वा शत्रु नाशनौ ॥४-३-९॥
transliteration: siṁha viprekṣitau vīrau mahābala parākramau ।śakra cāpa nibhe cāpe gṛhītvā śatru nāśanau ॥4-3-9॥

translations.english: 'Having the gaze of a lion, both of you are heroic in your stance. As each of you hold a bow resembling the rainbow, you seem to be mighty warriors eager to annihilate the enemies. With the valour of superior bulls and your shoulders resembling elephant's trunks, you look magnificent, handsome and brilliant. (No doubt,) you are the best among the humans.
